name: Haiku macro/sector rotation
strategy: Defensive quality rotation paired with sector mean-reversion in laggards, shorting QQQ momentum extremes to fund dividend-paying carry positions
novelty: Fade the AI/semiconductor super-cycle narrative after 2-year tech outperformance (+506% SOXL, +103% semis) by rotating defensively into quality healthcare/utilities/financials with 3-4% dividend yields, combining with mean-reversion bets in beaten-down value/materials sectors (-1% to -4% 6m performance), while using QQQ short hedge to protect against further tech valuation compression and fund carry income—fundamentally different from prior momentum-driven AI core strategies.
